extracted.intended_audience: prospective applicants (exceptional PhD students), nominating institutions, and general readers interested in the Schmidt Science Fellows program
extracted.subtask_description: Information and stated criteria for nomination and selection to the Schmidt Science Fellows postdoctoral fellowship, including required application materials and the program's selection qualities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institutional nomination / eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: The program invites a select group of the world's leading science and engineering institutions to nominate their "most exceptional" PhD students.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Nominees must be put forward by invited/nominating institutions; emphasis on being the institution's most exceptional PhD students. (No further eligibility details provided on this page.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Application component: research proposal
rubrics_metrics.description: Nominees then submit an application, consisting of a research proposal...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The research proposal is listed as a required part of the application; the page provides no additional guidance on length, format, or evaluation of the proposal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application component: personal statement
rubrics_metrics.description: Nominees then submit an application, consisting of... a personal statement...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Personal statement is a required application element; no further instructions or evaluation criteria are given on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application component: current CV
rubrics_metrics.description: Nominees then submit an application, consisting of... current CV...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A current curriculum vitae is required; the page does not specify format or detail expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application component: recommendation letters (4–7)
rubrics_metrics.description: Nominees then submit an application, consisting of... 4-7 recommendation letters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The program requires between four and seven recommendation letters as part of the application; no further guidance about who should write them or content is provided on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Selection criterion: extraordinary achievement
rubrics_metrics.description: The stated selection criteria are extraordinary achievement...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a core quality looked for in candidates; the page does not define metrics for "extraordinary achievement."

rubrics_metrics.name: Selection criterion: extraordinary degree of intelligence
rubrics_metrics.description: The stated selection criteria are... extraordinary degree of intelligence...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Named explicitly as a selection attribute; no operational definition or scoring guidance provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Selection criterion: scientific curiosity and innovation
rubrics_metrics.description: The stated selection criteria are... scientific curiosity and innovation...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes both curiosity and capacity for innovative work as qualities sought in fellows.

rubrics_metrics.name: Selection criterion: collaborative spirit
rubrics_metrics.description: The stated selection criteria are... collaborative spirit...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program values applicants who demonstrate ability and willingness to collaborate across disciplines or teams.

rubrics_metrics.name: Selection criterion: leadership
rubrics_metrics.description: The stated selection criteria are... leadership...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Leadership is explicitly listed as an evaluative quality; page gives no detail on what forms of leadership are prioritized (e.g., scientific leadership, community leadership).

rubrics_metrics.name: Selection criterion: ambition for social good
rubrics_metrics.description: The stated selection criteria are... an ambition for social good.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The fellowship seeks candidates motivated to use science/engineering for societal benefit; no further metrics provided on this page.
